boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Gettysburg College spaces for group work, campus events, outdoor breaks, recreation, and creative exchange, verified through current official sources.

cards.title: Use the Campus Living Room
cards.subtitle: A flexible gathering spot inside the College Union Building
cards.notes: Drop in for a small performance, open mic, organization event, or informal meetup near the CUB’s quick-service dining options.
cards.short_summary: The Junction turns a central CUB passage into a casual venue for conversation, performances, and student-led programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Gettysburg College describes CUB Junction as the campus living room and lists student performances, open mics, video-game tournaments, presentations, and drop-by events among its uses.
cards.source_title: Popular Campus Venues - Office of Student Activities and Greek Life
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to College Union Building access and any scheduled event restrictions.

cards.title: Gather Under the Atrium Skylight
cards.subtitle: An event space connecting sections of the College Union Building
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar for receptions, tabling, or organization programs here; event hosts must arrange food through College catering.
cards.short_summary: The Atrium provides a bright CUB setting for campus programs where students can circulate rather than remain seated.
cards.evidence_claim: Gettysburg College identifies the Atrium as a popular indoor campus venue and states that events held there must use the College’s catering services.
cards.source_title: Popular Campus Venues - Office of Student Activities and Greek Life
cards.access_notes: Event use is scheduled; outside food and beverages are not permitted for hosted events in this space.

cards.title: Treat the Lake Like a Lawn
cards.subtitle: Gettysburg’s centrally located field—not an actual lake
cards.notes: Bring a conversation, lawn activity, or outdoor study break; Adirondack chairs, lights, and fire pits support evening gathering.
cards.short_summary: Stine Lake is a central open lawn arranged for lounging, recreation, festivals, and student-group events.
cards.evidence_claim: Gettysburg College says Stine Lake is a large central field used to lounge, play, and socialize, with lights, Adirondack chairs, fire pits, concerts, fairs, and festivals.
cards.source_title: Popular Campus Venues - Office of Student Activities and Greek Life
cards.access_notes: The College describes the outdoor space as a 24-hour venue; organized activities may require scheduling.

cards.title: Find the Beach Without Water
cards.subtitle: The open lawn between Musselman Hall, Christ Chapel, and Stevens Hall
cards.notes: Spread out for a daytime break or look for scheduled lawn games, outdoor films, and drop-by programs on this sand-free “beach.”
cards.short_summary: Musselman Beach is a campus nickname for a broad lawn used for relaxing and outdoor programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Gettysburg College identifies Musselman Beach as the large field between Musselman Hall, Christ Chapel, and Stevens Hall and documents relaxation, lawn games, outdoor movies, and drop-by events there.
cards.source_title: Popular Campus Venues - Office of Student Activities and Greek Life
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor lawn; access can be affected by weather or scheduled events.

cards.title: Meet at the Edge of the Quarry
cards.subtitle: A covered gathering place overlooking Quarry Pond
cards.notes: Bring a picnic or plan a group craft session at the tables; reserve or confirm permission before organizing a larger gathering.
cards.short_summary: Quarry Pavilion combines pond views, picnic tables, and grills near Gettysburg’s athletic fields.
cards.evidence_claim: Gettysburg College states that Quarry Pavilion overlooks Quarry Pond, sits near athletic fields, and is equipped with picnic tables and charcoal grills for gatherings and picnics.
cards.source_title: Popular Campus Venues - Office of Student Activities and Greek Life
cards.access_notes: Organized use may require a reservation; follow College rules for grills and scheduled athletic events.

cards.title: Share a Field With Campus Groups
cards.subtitle: The flat lawn bordering the CUB, Plank Gym, and Apple Hall
cards.notes: Use the field for an approved lawn game or intramural activity, and leave space when the marching band or another group is rehearsing.
cards.short_summary: Memorial Field is a central activity lawn that shifts between recreation, intramurals, and marching-band rehearsal.
cards.evidence_claim: Gettysburg College describes Memorial Field as a large flat field beside the CUB, Plank Gym, and Apple Hall, used for intramurals, lawn games, field days, and marching-band rehearsals.
cards.source_title: Popular Campus Venues - Office of Student Activities and Greek Life
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is subject to weather, rehearsals, intramurals, and other scheduled uses.

cards.title: Move the Meetup Outdoors
cards.subtitle: The named event lawn beside the College Union Building
cards.notes: Check student-organization listings for scheduled programming here, or use the lawn considerately when it is not reserved for an event.
cards.short_summary: CUB Green extends the student-center gathering zone into a named outdoor campus venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Gettysburg College lists CUB Green among its popular outdoor campus venues available for student activities and events.
cards.source_title: Popular Campus Venues - Office of Student Activities and Greek Life
cards.access_notes: Event use may require advance scheduling; ordinary outdoor access can change with weather or campus operations.

cards.title: Book the Library’s Semi-Private Room
cards.subtitle: A reservable lower-level room for solo or group work
cards.notes: Reserve up to seven days ahead for a focused session, keeping the booking within the library’s two-hour daily limit per person or group.
cards.short_summary: Room 006 gives Gettysburg students a defined semi-private setting for individual concentration or group collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Musselman Library identifies lower-level Room 006 as a semi-private reservable study room for individual or group use, bookable for up to two hours per day and seven days in advance.
cards.source_title: Reserve A Library Space - Gettysburg College
cards.access_notes: Reservations are limited to Gettysburg College community members and may be made up to seven days ahead.

cards.title: Use Art to Start a Conversation
cards.subtitle: The Main Gallery and Project Space inside Schmucker Hall
cards.notes: Pair a gallery visit with a class discussion or student-group conversation, and check the official page for the current exhibition schedule.
cards.short_summary: Schmucker Art Gallery is a shared cultural space for exhibitions, talks, student work, and cross-disciplinary discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: Gettysburg College says Schmucker Art Gallery welcomes the campus community through exhibitions and programming and encourages students to use the space for discussions and interdisciplinary connections.
cards.access_notes: The gallery is on Schmucker Hall’s main floor; consult its official page for current exhibitions and posted hours.

cards.entity_name: John F. Jaeger Center for Athletics, Recreation, and Fitness
cards.title: Try Recreation Beyond the Weight Room
cards.subtitle: A student recreation complex with fitness and climbing facilities
cards.notes: Review Campus Recreation offerings before visiting, then choose among fitness classes, bouldering, climbing, swimming, or intramurals.
cards.short_summary: The Jaeger Center brings multiple forms of student recreation and group wellness programming under one roof.
cards.evidence_claim: Gettysburg College documents that the Jaeger Center includes a fitness center, bouldering area, 30-foot climbing tower, multipurpose fitness room, gym, natatorium, and athletic-training facilities.
cards.access_notes: Facility participation is governed by Campus Recreation eligibility, current schedules, and activity-specific safety rules.
